about: State of Muse's aggregation work across the four sports, drawn as the Visual Dashboard's aggregation web. Maintained by the strategic window at every wave close from the archive (eignacio1/sports-intel-archive, commit below), TO_MUSE.md and the bot repo. built = delivered and in the repo/archive; pending = a ticket or block open now; future = planned, no ticket yet. Operator 2026-10-21 08:11 PT: 'give us an idea of pending, built, future'. Where it is going (operator 2026-11-02 21:40 PT): the raw tables are the starting place for conceptual aggregation - compound splits such as "mid range jumper shooting archetypes during 2-4 minute close games on the road with your primary point guard hurt against a team that plays zone" - and "the interpretative data should be able to feed each other as each branch gets built - exponentially making each branch easier to build". Each sport's 'Compound splits' spoke is that layer; its notes name the base branches it is built from. Muse's standing role (charter v3 amendment, 2026-11-02): aggregator and scout; every card names the engine and factor it feeds and whether the bot can capture the source itself. As of 11-02 the bot reads none of the archive's records directly (177,346); Muse's value so far is the scouting (fees, data routes, what does not exist).
